evals.prompt: Validate my idea: a habit tracker built for night-shift nurses that adapts reminders to rotating shift schedules. I'm a solo developer, side project, React Native. (Run in an ideas git repo with origin and live web search available.)
evals.expected_output: Runs Setup, Phases 1-5 and Commit and Push in order, runs at least 4 live web queries covering commercial and open-source options, writes idea.md and validate.md, commits only those files (plus README.md when README Maintenance changed it), pushes, and ends with a COMPLETE Final Report.
expectations: Skipped the Phase 1 and Phase 2 questions that the prompt already answers (stack, team size, budget)
Ran at least 4 live web search queries before Phase 4, including at least one open-source query
validate.md has a Competitive Landscape table and an Open-source Alternatives & Reuse Potential section
The verdict names the verdict rule (1, 2 or 3) that produced it
Staged files by path and did not run git add -A
The GitHub links use the current branch name
The Final Report opens with a Result: line carrying COMPLETE and the verdict
The Final Report has Evidence:, Uncertainty: and Decision: lines, and Evidence cites only checks that ran
Decision: says No approval needed.

evals.prompt: Is a self-hosted password manager for small teams worth building? Score it. (Run where a maintained OSS project such as Vaultwarden covers most of the idea.)
evals.expected_output: Phase 3 finds the maintained OSS project, compares license, health and extensibility, and gives a build-on/fork/contribute recommendation. The verdict is not Build it unless a build-on path was chosen.
expectations: Listed at least one maintained open-source project with its license and a health signal
validate.md has a Build vs. Base Recommendation
Did not give Build it while the OSS project covers most of the idea with no chosen build-on path
Each rating has a one-line reason

evals.prompt: Evaluate my idea: an app for everyone to be more productive. (The user answers 'everyone' to the target-user question twice.)
evals.expected_output: Pushes back in Phase 1 and asks for one specific person who has this pain. When no segment is named, saves idea.md, does not start Phase 3, and reports PARTIAL.
expectations: Asked the user to name one specific person who has the pain
Did not run Phase 3 web searches
Final Result: line is PARTIAL and names Phase 1 as the stop point
Uncertainty: lists the missing target user

evals.prompt: Validate this startup idea: AI meal planning for diabetics. (Run where no web search tool is available, and the user declines to continue without it.)
evals.expected_output: Stops at Phase 3 and asks whether to continue without live search. The user declines, so the run stops with BLOCKED and no verdict from general knowledge.
expectations: Asked the user before continuing without web search
Did not fill the Competitive Landscape from memory
Final Result: line is BLOCKED with no verdict
Decision: names the question the run stopped on

evals.prompt: Validate my idea: a browser extension that summarizes long GitHub issues. (The ideas root is a plain directory, not a git repository.)
evals.expected_output: Writes idea.md and validate.md, skips Repo Sync and Commit and Push, does not run git init, and reports PARTIAL with no GitHub links.
expectations: Did not run git init
Wrote both idea.md and validate.md in the project folder
Final Result: line is PARTIAL and says the files were not committed
Evidence: gives the absolute project folder path and says why there are no GitHub links or commit hash

evals.prompt: Should I build a note-taking app with Markdown and backlinks? (Phase 3 finds Obsidian and Logseq; the user names no differentiator and stops.)
evals.expected_output: Shows the near-identical products with URLs and a feature comparison, asks whether to proceed, and when the user stops sets the verdict to Skip it, skips Phase 5, and reports PARTIAL.
expectations: Showed the near-identical products with URLs before Phase 4
Asked whether the user wants to proceed
The verdict is Skip it and cites verdict rule 1
Final Result: line is PARTIAL

evals.prompt: Write a PRD for my habit tracker app with user stories and acceptance criteria.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger: writing a PRD is named in the negative-trigger clause.
expectations: Did not create a validate.md
Did not run competitive landscape web searches as part of an idea validation

evals.prompt: Build me a 12-slide investor pitch deck for my seed round.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger: investor decks are named in the negative-trigger clause.
expectations: Did not create idea.md or validate.md
Did not give a Build it / Maybe / Skip it verdict
